title: ‘It’s not like he’s naive’: As Cowboys hear Brian Schottenheimer criticism, they’re not content to just beat injury-riddled Eagles

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: ‘It’s not like he’s naive’: As Cowboys hear Brian Schottenheimer criticism, they’re not content to just beat injury-riddled Eagles
sources.description: The Cowboys coach's postgame press conference was far terser than usual, perhaps not coincidentally amid the criticism he’s received and the questions about his confidence.
